title: TUI from Zero — three pillars
subtitle: render · react · compose — built on aprender-present-terminal

slot_anchors.narration: Black canvas. The space we will fill.
Pillar one. Render. CellBuffer, Widget, DiffRenderer.
Pillar two. React. init, update, view — the Elm loop.
Pillar three. Compose. Sparkline, CpuGrid, ProcessTable.
All three pillars rest on aprender-present-* — from crates.io.
Five modules, ten lessons, twenty-two videos, three contracts.
Five weeks. Three pillars. Zero JavaScript. Build a ptop.
